Ana (AE): Hey team — RFX received from OrphicHealth. They want: filled security questionnaire, capability matrix, and a POC pricing breakdown. Attached the draft capability matrix: `cap_matrix_orphic_v1.xlsx` (drive link below). Key asks we need to clarify: 1) Can we commit to ~99.9% GPU availability for a short POC targeting ~5k qps embeddings? 2) KMS/HSM support + key-wrap options for their on-prem data flow. 3) Pricing tiers: reserved vs burst. @Matt S. - Solutions @Rita (Security) PTAL, need answers + timeline — they expect a response in 3 business days.

Matt S. - Solutions: Got it. Quick notes: 5k qps embeddings is doable but depends on model, batch sizing, and whether they accept quantized weights. Two feasible paths:
- Dedicated Reserved pool (recommended) — predictable throughput, we can commit to SLA for the POC if they contract a reserved block.
- Hosted with burst routing — cheaper but no hard GPU SLA; we can offer fallback to a smaller model.

Rough cost sketch (for internal use / ballpark): reserved baseline for this throughput: ~$1200/hr for a dedicated 8xA100 pool during a multi-hour test. Hosted-burst route estimate: metered at token/embedding unit + burst premium (~30% uplift). I'll prepare a capability matrix with measured qps for the model variants. Draft uploaded: https://redwood.app/files/cap_matrix_orphic_v1.xlsx :eyes:

Dan E. (Infra): For the 5k qps target, recommended infra footprint and settings:

```
- Model: open-embed-2048 / redwood-embed-v2
- Batch size: dynamic up to 512
- Dedicated nodes: 8 x A100-80GB with NVLink
- KV caching: enabled for prefix reuse
- Network: private peering and 10Gbps egress reservation
```

Also need to confirm whether OrphicHealth will run the POC in our Dedicated or their VPC Private deployment — that changes the network and KMS flow. If private deployment, HSM integration steps add ~3 business days + legal SLA checks.

Rita (Security): I reviewed the questionnaire. Top blockers:
- HSM attestation / key custody proof (they require BYOK with HSM key wrapping)
- Data residency / logging retention specifics
- Contract language for incident notification window (they want <1hr)

I can attach SOC2 Type II report and our encryption whitepaper, and fill the RFX Qs where we have standard answers. For HSM: we support KMS integrations and can support customer-managed keys via a cross-account KMS + key-wrap; for on-prem HSM we need an architecture review but we can do encrypted transit with key-wrapping in an HSM gateway.

Rita (Security): Links I'll include:
- SOC2: https://redwood.app/security/soc2_redwood.pdf
- KMS/HSM guide: https://redwood.app/docs/kms-hsm-integration

Ana (AE): Thanks — timeline reminder: OrphicHealth expects the completed RFX and capability matrix plus pricing by EOD in 3 business days. Can we draft the POC plan (hours, runbook, success KPIs) and a short pricing appendix? I can own the email to their procurement once we have docs.

Matt S. - Solutions: I will populate the capability matrix with measured qps for the two model options (quantized / full-precision) and add a POC ops checklist. Also will include a canary fallback (lower-capacity model) if Dedicated capacity hits saturation. ETA for my draft: tomorrow EOD.

Dan E. (Infra): I'll put together a minimal benchmark command and a config snippet for the POC. Example bench command:

```
ri bench --model redwood-embed-v2 --concurrency 100 --batch-max 512 --duration 600
```

Will also note required network peering and a checklist for on-prem HSM testing.

Rita (Security): I can finish the questionnaire sections I own and flag anything legal needs to sign off on. Also need Product to confirm logging retention defaults for Dedicated vs Private. @Ana (AE) please confirm whether they require custom retention.

deploy-bot: POC sandbox env scheduled: deploy-job/orphic-poc-sandbox queued (eta 1765443000). :rocket:

Ana (AE): OK — action items:
- Matt: capability matrix + POC ops checklist (due tomorrow EOD)
- Dan: benchmark snippet + infra checklist (due tomorrow EOD)
- Rita: security questionnaire attachments + SOC2 (due in 2 business days)
- Ana: compile final RFX and send to customer once drafts are in

Ana (AE): Also please add a short pricing appendix with two options: Reserved hourly commit and Hosted-burst metered with example cost cases (1 hour, 4 hour, 24 hour). I'll consolidate and send.

Matt S. - Solutions: Will do. Marking this thread for follow-up. :thumbsup:

Rita (Security): FYI I'm flagging HSM attestation to Legal — they may want an NDA addendum for the architecture diagram. :eyes:

Dan E. (Infra): Noted. Will add a note about expected cloud egress and peering steps for procurement.

Ana (AE): Great — thanks everyone. If anything new pops up, drop it here.
